s: I was working for Magnolia Home Theater during that time (after Best Buy acquired them), and was able to get M&K at a 75% discount through an employee accommodation program. Every Magnolia installation advisor recommended them, so I took their advice and put in S150s for my L/R, a matching in-wall version behind my screen (Stewart micro-perf), 4x SS-150s for my surrounds, and their big 12” THX sub (model#?). I couldn’t have done it at $10k retail, but $2500 for the entire setup made it a no-brainer. The sound has always been outstanding, and I’ve only ever dialed it in using my receivers’ room calibration modes.
